## How it was tested
- [ ] Unit / integration tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test` (web) / `uv run pytest` (science, api)
- [ ] Screenshots or preview-channel link for UI changes

## Checklist
- [ ] Every commit is a meaningful Conventional Commit (one logical change, body says why)
- [ ] Scored indicators use NASA data; any non-NASA data is an optional, labelled extra
- [ ] New datasets or libraries are OSI/open-licensed and listed in `docs/DATA_SOURCES.md`
- [ ] Security: no secrets, inputs validated, rules or headers updated if needed
- [ ] Accessibility: keyboard reachable, labels, reduced motion respected
- [ ] AI assistance recorded in `docs/AI_USE.md` if used
